title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-10-04
lineage: KSAN-FM Master Reel > Barry Glassberg's 1st gen Reel (Dolby B Decoded) > PCM > CDR > EAC > CoolEdit2000 (see notes) > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent quadcast soundboard capture of the legendary Oct 4 1970 Winterland set – soaring China>Rider, magical Sugar Magnolia and tight Cold Rain/Snow – though only half of the original stereo mix is present.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this October‑4‑1970 Winterland performance, citing a blistering China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider sequence, a Wah‑wah‑laden Sugar Magnolia, and powerful vocal work from Phil and Bob. The source is a cleaned‑up matrix of the historic KSAN/KQED quad broadcast, offering crisp soundboard‑like clarity but missing some stereo announcements and portions of the original mix. Overall the music shines, even if the recording is technically incomplete.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (12 out of 15) award 4‑5 stars and praise the performance and sound quality, while a few note missing broadcast elements and give low scores; the strong musical consensus outweighs the technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Derived from the historic KSAN/KQED quad‑cast broadcast; sound is clear and balanced like a soundboard, but only half of the original stereo mix is present and some KSAN station announcements are missing.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for tight transitions and high energy, especially the mid‑set jam between China>Rider and the powerful Sugar Magnolia; a few reviewers note uneven moments later in the night (e.g., Airplane), but overall the performance is considered one of the band's classic early‑70s shows.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His Wah‑wah pedal work is described as magical on Sugar Magnolia and his solo on China>Rider is called mystical.
band_member_comments.Phil: Vocals are noted as dominant; bass sound is praised as fat, funky, and hot throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned for mixing up the “soup” during transitions and trading licks after Good Lovin'.
